assertion_audit.failure_condition: Precision configuration leaves JAX x64 disabled.
The governed fixture includes no cells or excludes no cells; this is a nonempty-domain positive control.
Restore the prepared-frame pseudo-wall default: material flags become true outside the independently selected physical polygon. The recorded mutation produces this failure.
The governed ring or raster no longer yields the independently pinned 527-cell count on this grid.

Restore the pseudo-wall default: the prepared material count becomes 1089 while the physical-route count remains 527. This is not self-equality: the reference builder is called explicitly with None, independent of the caller default being tested.
Explicit expansion=0.02 no longer selects the all-grid control; this deliberately tests the retained control, not limiter exclusion.

Stopping-rule CLI drops the frame, forces a wall choice, discards the explicit flag or fails to reach the captured preparation seam; expected selection comes independently from argv and the parametrized fixture.

Serialization _self_check raises on its known nonfinite/list inputs, or _counters_self_check returns 1 after miscounting padded, accepted, refused or damped events against its hand-enumerated expected tuples.
Convergence CLI drops frame 179, forces pseudo-wall use, loses explicit expansion, or fails to reach captured run_frame; this tests parsed forwarding rather than asserting an input against itself.

A receipt is refused, tensor orientation/shape differs, saved flat state differs from its flux array, mask counts disagree with JSON, or an arm misses the pinned 527/1089 material count; serialized-state equality checks consistency and is not evidence of solver correctness by itself.

Wall-distance positive control fails on wall points; domain is empty/all-grid; polygon-recomputed support containment disagrees with JSON; a physical mask differs from the limiter polygon; physical support escapes; a physical axis is outside; or saved axis coordinates/containment disagree with JSON.
The cohort is not twelve rows, any of six subprocess receipts is missing/nonzero/duplicated, the H200 success receipt is absent, or all supports are empty.
Reference polishing runs without x64, fails to converge, or returns a Hessian classification other than the independently expected extremum and saddle.
The reused text checker detects overlap/clipping or a margin-label anchor lies in a plot axes; actual committed output was also visually inspected.

assertion_independence: No added regression assertion compares a returned value solely with the same value the test supplied to make that return happen; paired serialization equality assertions are identified as consistency checks, not physical validation. The prepared-frame fixture replaces expensive build_profile operands, so this review credits protection of the changed caller-selection contract rather than a new integration guarantee for untouched product construction.

authority.interpretation: The accepted locate result explicitly changes the fix and its tests: caller physical-route selection, rather than modification of the product missing-mask default. The original outside-axis test and MAST rerun are not treated as unsatisfied obligations of the replacement contract; product and MAST callers are unchanged.

figure_inspection.method: Extracted each SVG from the reviewed git object, rasterized with installed ImageMagick convert, opened both resulting 1400px PNGs with view_image.
figure_inspection.renderer_caveat: System Python lacks cairosvg, so ImageMagick was used; its optional delegate reported a read-only /tmp temporary path, but both output images were produced and directly inspected.
figure_inspection.result: Both legible; no text overlap or clipping; margin labels clear; paired support cells, limiter, terminal/reference contours and null markers visible; diverted control visibly above the limiter.

item_verdicts.diff: Read all five commits from 04d969738a47a2d5bc31544c03980d1e4afcd94c to bbda569dea757dbe4ccb834dab87ba2cd216df00, including the caller defaults, explicit control forwarding, terminal measurement/refusal handling, guards, verifier, renderer and evidence; both committed SVGs were rasterized and visually inspected without clipped or colliding text.

item_verdicts.manifest: The source manifest.md reports five commits and ten changed paths with complete base/head suite arms, and its 4-pass baseline, 12-pass final head and 2-failure negative control reconcile with the actual named logs; its MAST and nonconvergence caveats are explicit.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The original prompt scope was widened explicitly in resume-1-advice.txt:3 to include the convergence and stopping-rule prototype directories, and all ten paths in the five-commit diff fall within that revised scope.

justifications.durability: Restoring expansion=0.02 at measure_branches.py:180 makes the independent exclusion and pinned 527-cell assertions at tests/test_material_mask_limiter.py:106,112-113 fail as negative-control.log records, while the parametrized CLI tests fail on dropped or forced surface selection.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_material_mask_limiter.py:102-166 is backed by final-measured-head-gate.log at the reviewed head, negative-control.log explicitly fails both limiter guards, and check_measurement.py:20-83 verifies twelve saved states and six successful H200 subprocesses against their receipts.
justifications.fit: measure_branches.py:180 extends its existing preparation seam, the CLIs name the pseudo-wall control explicitly, and diiid_material_mask/render.py:20-31 uses the repository's precision, ink, poloidal painter and text-check owners without introducing prohibited source names.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/diiid_forward_convergence/measure_branches.py:180,206 and diagnose_step_gate.py:85 select the governed route that benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:1047-1079 rasterizes into 527 material cells, with all six measured physical supports inside the limiter.
justifications.reuse: Searches for material rasterization, terminal measurement, contour rendering, stationary-point polishing and text checking found the owners in wall_mask.py:70, diiid_forward_gs_match.py:1020, measure_branches.py:180 and _solve, flux_surface_connectivity.py:polish_stationary_points, poloidal.py:draw_flux_contours/draw_nulls/draw_wall and render_panels.py:435, which the added experiment wrappers call rather than replacing their mechanisms.
justifications.scope_discipline: The ten changed paths match the original source prompt plus resume-1-advice.txt:3's explicit prototype-directory grant, and no product default or benchmark baseline was changed.

limitations: No suite rerun: the review reads the source node's completed logs as instructed.
This review is of the specified base/head pair, not the newer orientation checkout HEAD.
All twelve measured arms remain nonconverged; this is reported evidence, not a convergence repair. The stored evidence retains native contour and EFIT wall-gap caveats.
